name: code-architecture
description: Engineering process: plan-before-code, YAGNI, SOLID principles applied with judgment, task orchestration, work verification — enforced by a blocking Stop hook that refuses a completion claim when files were edited but nothing ran afterward — low-cognitive-load code, KISS/DRY simplicity principles. Owns structure at both levels: code (units, interfaces, file placement) and system (service boundaries on data ownership, scaling paths, cache placement, sync vs async integration, domain modeling) via the system-design and domain-modeling skills and the system-architect worker.
